# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

This repository is maintained on a best-effort basis for current work. Security fixes are generally applied on the default branch.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not open public issues for suspected security vulnerabilities.

Instead, report privately by contacting the maintainer via GitHub:

- https://github.com/markheydon

Include:

- A clear description of the issue.
- Steps to reproduce (if relevant).
- Potential impact.
- Suggested mitigation (if known).

You can expect acknowledgement as soon as practical, followed by triage and remediation planning.
